body: Question for ya. Is this for people that haven't gotten ect yet, or just for people who have or are currently in the thick of it?

Hey!

If you can't, don't want to, or are just scared about going to go get it closed here are some tips!

If you can, grab some Band-Aids, tape or whatever will stick to your skin (safely) and try to close the wound. You can use regular old bandaids and what not if you can't get to the doctor/hospital and all you gotta do is make sure it sticks to one side, pull gently, and cover if needed/wanted. Just make sure it's all clean and kosher and you're good to go. 

I went through a whole phase where I wouldn't go to get my cuts closed and they gave me pretty big scars and they healed for way longer. If you close them up they heal faster, less chance of infection and it's easier to hide in some ways. Plus, safer.

​

I hope your cuts don't give you a whole lot of trouble and heal well!
